_doc: Arguments the importer gives an object when it asks Max for the object's default box. Max will not create these objects bare: it saves an error box with no inlets or outlets. The arguments are stripped again before the box is stored.
_doc_free_text: Objects whose argument is an expression in free text. Their refpages list the parts of the expression as five required arguments, which no real expression matches, so the importer stores one required argument of any type.
_doc_not_aliases: Names Max's objectmappings files map to another object's file although they are not that object: the importer does not make them aliases. xbendin2 has 3 outlets where xbendin has 2, and xbendout2 has 3 inlets where xbendout has 2.
_doc_required_count: How many of the arguments a refpage marks as required Max really needs, for objects whose boxes in Max's own shipped patches work with fewer: join, select and noteout work bare, split works with one argument. The importer keeps that many as required and moves the rest to the front of the optional arguments.
